facts.text: I am looking for writing prompts to help me experiment with different styles and genres.
I like the sound of a sci-fi prompt about a world with no gravity.
I like exploring the psychological effects of living in a gravity-free environment.
I am interested in exploring a character who has grown up in a zero-gravity environment and has never experienced gravity before.
I am interested in exploring the idea of a character who is struggling to come to terms with their past trauma.
I would like writing prompts that explore the theme of trauma, healing, and recovery.
